notes.title: Beta Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
Thank you so much to all of the beta-testers for your work in making this game so much more polished and fun than it would have otherwise been. My heartful thanks goes out to you! In the next patch, I will include all of your names in the credits, so please get your desired credited name to me if you haven't already.

In this patch, I've added:

12 new Steam Achievements! (you may need to restart Steam to see them)
Numerous QoL improvements such as a new cutscene movement hold icon, lower main menu sound, and not requiring re-listening to the crimper's log if you die in the tunnels
A few big fixes or adjustments such as preventing the fire light from confusing players as to the location of the fire.


Thank you again! <3

Kim

notes.title: Beta Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
In this patch you'll find additional performance settings, some QoL changes like an in-game volume adjuster, fixes for a couple unusual soft-locking bugs, and some new challenges in the last part of the game. Thank you so much to all the wonderful beta-testers! <3
Kim

notes.title: Beta Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you so much to all the beta testers who have already started to give feedback! I’ve made a number of small changes and fixes with today’s patch. The most important of these are two quality of life changes: (1) bumping up the brightness of the game quite a lot and (2) adding a settings menu to change windowing mode, graphical quality, and audio volume level. I also wrote code to add some additional settings like custom key bindings and fine tuned visual quality, but I still need to finish the UI for these. Thanks again to everyone who’s tested and those who are planning to test this weekend!
<3 Kim
